attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page. The page argues against two things about him and this folder follows it in both. It will not stand behind the year: the episcopal lists put him in the second half of the second century, specifically 160, «χρονολόγηση που πρότεινε ο μητροπολίτης Αμασείας Ανθιμος Αλεξούδης, χωρίς ωστόσο να έχει στη διάθεσή του κάποια επαρκή στοιχεία» — without his having any sufficient evidence — so this folder carries no dates at all. And it refuses the identification with Nicholas the Confessor of the Synodikon of Orthodoxy as «παντελώς αστήρικτο», wholly unfounded. The day itself it does vouch for, out of the Constantinopolitan Synaxarion and the Menaia. It prints no hymn.
